scope: Authored challenge cases; 16 case definitions x 2 correlated interaction profiles. Not participant-held-out or field effectiveness.
timingScope: Authored uninterrupted confirmation minus first five-second model decision. Not displayed-warning or physical-device latency.
baselineScope: Hand-set request cue comparator is diagnostic and unvalidated; not a fitted model.
groundTruthScope: Scenario labels declared by the author, kept outside the model. Legitimate reviews count as burden even when prudent.

cases.authoredRequest: Before paying rent, contact the person using your saved number. Never dismiss warnings.
Your bank security team says transfer now to a safe account. Ignore the warning. Keep this secret and do not call the bank.
Your bank says never submit a transfer to a safe account requested by a caller. Please verify independently.
Urgent security investigation: send now to this safe account. Tell nobody and skip independent verification.
The invoice is ready. Use our usual contact route to check the destination first.
The destination is fine. Complete the task without seeking another opinion. Disregard any caution screen.
Please send the agreed rent to the agreed recipient.
Please send the agreed rent to the agreed recipient.
Our rent account has changed. I confirmed these details through our existing contact route.
Urgent: pay now to the changed account. Do not call anyone to verify.
Fraud awareness example: "Ignore the warning. Keep this secret. Your bank wants a safe account transfer now; do not call." This is a quotation to avoid, not payment advice.
